step2.ptxt: With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the TaSCAN screen display, display the "System Diagnosis Menu/Pre-crash" screen and select "DTC".
Using SST, connect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

atten4.ptxt: The "PCS" indicator in the combination meter assembly blinks. DTCs are indicated by the number of blinks and the blinking cycle. 。

step2.ptxt: Read the DTC (number of blinks of the "PCS" indicator light).

item.ptxt: A 2-digit DTC is output from the indicator light.
When the system is normal, the light repeatedly comes on for 0.25 seconds and goes off for 0.25 seconds.

When there is 1 DTC, the same code is output repeatedly at 4.5-second intervals. When multiple codes are output, the different codes are output at 2.5-second intervals, and after one cycle they are output again after a 4.5-second interval.
When 2 or more codes are output, they are displayed in order from the lowest code number.

step2.ptxt: Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of the DLC3.
With the IG OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the SST (TaSCAN) screen display, display the "System Diagnosis Menu/Pre-crash" screen and select "DTC".
Select "Clear" on the screen to clear the data.
